name: FIR-Bench-Announcements-FinQA
description: A financial question-answering benchmark built from company announcements that measures a model's ability to extract and reason about financial facts and perform numeric reasoning based on announcement text. Tasks typically require extraction of entities, numeric computation, and concise factual answers grounded in announcements.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific dataset for financial QA hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing interest among financial NLP researchers.
